title: Propagation paths
assumptions: Closed three-site Hermitian chain; g=1, delta=0.5, hbar=1.
Initial amplitude vector (1,0,0); fixed site basis.
output_meaning: A Taylor sum of weighted matrix walks predicts the next short step; a finite analogue of diagrammatic expansion, not QED Feynman rules.
limits: A scoped calculation; no universal physical interpretation or new Lean certificate is implied.
